thread:
marie: kicking off a config-only change for traffic-shim and tinybatch limits in canary.

marie: change window = 13:00-14:30 UTC, canary 5% -> 25% over 30m, fallback to previous pin if errors > 1%.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: config-only | env=prod | change=traffic-shim,tinybatch | canary=5% | id=deploy-6753

leo: note: lowering tinybatch can increase per-request latency. monitor p50/p95 and tail qps on the canary tenants.

meera: running late on a dependent infra change; i'll be oncall during this window if we need rollback.

```
traffic_shim: {fanout_max: 80, fanout_mode: "adaptive"}
tinybatch: {max_batch_size: 12, batch_timeout_ms: 15}
```

deploy-bot: canary update: 25% ramp scheduled at 1752468430 if no gate failures.

aj: if we need fast rollback, run `deployctl rollback deploy-6753 --immediate` (ops key required).

marie: ok proceeding. timeline: canary start now -> gate at +15m -> ramp at +30m -> hold for 30m -> clear.

deploy-bot: canary metrics at +5m: p50 +2ms, p95 +18ms, error-rate 0.2%. No action.
